snippet.title: Bound by Love - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Yokoshima is an unsuccessful magazine editor who is in love with the raven-haired beauty of the same company, Hazuki Ichinose. When she is tasked to transfer overseas, he must enact a plan to take her for himself.
